# GfxMode3D <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Display](Blitz3D-Display)

</div>


```blitzbasic
GfxMode3D:Int32 mode:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | In | Int32 | required | Number of the mode, 1 to [CountGfxModes3D](CountGfxModes3D). |

**Returns:** True if the mode can show 3D.

## Description

Tells whether the given mode from the list of modes can be used for 3D.
